label: Source
help: Point the camera at a code, scan a saved image, or paste a code's text to inspect it. Whatever the source, the code is read on this device - nothing is uploaded.

label: Image
help: A photo or screenshot containing a code. The bytes stay in memory on this device.

label: Code text
help: Paste the exact text a scanner returned, to inspect it with the same safety checks without pointing a camera.

label: Remember recent scans
help: Keeps a short list you can look back at, cleared with one tap. Passwords and other secrets are never kept.
